zh: 老实说，我不喜欢那个聚会。
en: {Honestly|Frankly|To be honest}, I didn't enjoy the party.

zh: 也许我们下周可以聚一聚。
en: {Maybe|Perhaps} we could catch up next week.

zh: 我完全同意你的看法。
en: I {totally|completely|absolutely|entirely|fully} agree with you.

zh: 当然啦，很明显，你要是忙的话就不用来。
en: {Obviously|Of course}, you don't have to come if you're busy.

zh: 我见到陌生人的时候有点儿害羞。
en: I'm {kind of|sort of|a bit|a little|slightly|rather} shy when I meet new people.

zh: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢小聚会而不是大派对。
en: {Personally}, I prefer small gatherings to big parties.

zh: 我们大约五年前最初是在网上认识的。
en: We first met {online} about five years ago.

zh: 抱歉，我真的是刚刚才进门，能回头打给你吗？
en: Sorry, I've {literally|only} just walked in the door. Can I call you back?

zh: 你当真要穿那个去参加婚礼？
en: Are you {seriously|really|actually} going to wear that to the wedding?

zh: 我真的很感谢你的帮助。
en: I {really|truly|genuinely} appreciate your help.

zh: 我们认识至少十年了。
en: We've known each other for {at least} ten years.

zh: 不可否认，我对他是有点没礼貌。
en: {Admittedly}, I was a bit rude to him.

zh: 我们不再怎么见面了。
en: We don't see each other much {any more|anymore|now|these days|nowadays}.

zh: 对了，顺便说一下，你听说莎拉订婚了吗？
en: {By the way|Incidentally}, did you hear that Sarah got engaged?

zh: 我们可以一起去听音乐会。
en: We could go to the concert {together}.

zh: 他问得那么客气，我都没法拒绝。
en: He asked so {politely|nicely} that I couldn't say no.

zh: 最理想的情况是，我们找个市中心的地方见面，这样谁都不用开太远。
en: {Ideally}, we'd meet somewhere central so nobody has to drive far.

zh: 我绝对没有想惹你不高兴的意思。
en: I {certainly|definitely|really} didn't mean to upset you.

zh: 说来也怪，我们上的是同一所学校，却从没见过面。
en: {Strangely|Oddly|Funnily|Weirdly} enough, we went to the same school but never met.

zh: 我待不了多久，但我无论如何都会来。
en: I can't stay long, but I'll come {anyway|regardless}.
